_comment: tiny-chat EXPLORATORY successive-halving arm (experiments/tiny_chat_2026-10/PREREGISTRATION.md amendment 1; plan experiments/tiny_chat_2026-10/asha_plan.json). 27 random configurations (shape, peak lr, warmup, dialogue share) trained from scratch for 1000 steps; the top 9 by base-model Carry-5 acc_gold retrain for 3000; the top 3 for the full 10000 steps, then SFT and Carry-5 as the E cells. Promotion runs on the VM (asha_promote_*); candidates not promoted end FAILED with 'not promoted' in their log. Worst case 19.5 L4 VM-hours; cap 20 (the runner's --max-hours). Launch through tools/colab_chat/tiny_chat_asha.py drive, which keeps ART/asha_state.json (every result and decision home so far) current for the runner's --upload asha_state.json=..., so a replaced VM can still promote. Upload vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf too. Dialogue levels [0, 17, 35, 70]% (copies), E1 at 35% (design.json final).
